language_policy: ISO C17 for engine, app, tools, UI and tests; OpenCL C 1.2 is the only allowed GPU kernel language exception
closed_decisions: OpenCL 1.2 API and OpenCL C 1.2 kernels with mandatory CPU C17 fallback
No third-party engine or runtime libraries
First ecosystem: 2 km by 2 km temperate mixed woodland-edge mosaic with four connected habitats
First species: red deer, red fox, European rabbit, wild boar
Reference cinematic profile: 8-core-class CPU, 32 GB RAM, 12 GB VRAM; native 4K 30 FPS target
No technical questions to project owner; OpenHands resolves implementation details within fixed decisions
User-visible accepted milestones ship as prereleases; stable 1.0 only after full product gates
